sql.list:
SELECT report_id, target_type, target_id, reporter_user_id, reason, description, evidence_url, status, priority, handled_by, created_at, updated_at, resolved_at, total
FROM (
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT r.* FROM n_moderation_reports r
  WHERE (:status IS NULL OR r.status = :status)
    AND (:reason IS NULL OR r.reason = :reason)
    AND (:target_type IS NULL OR r.target_type = :target_type)
), ranked AS (
  SELECT filtered.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at DESC, report_id DESC) AS rn FROM filtered
)
SELECT r.report_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reporter_user_id, r.reason, r.description, r.evidence_url,
       r.status, r.priority, r.handled_by,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.created_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS created_at,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.updated_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.resolved_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS resolved_at, totals.total, r.rn
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM filtered) totals
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
) ORDER BY rn
sql.read:
SELECT r.report_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reporter_user_id, r.reason, r.description, r.evidence_url,
       r.status, r.priority, r.handled_by,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.created_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS created_at,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.updated_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.resolved_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS resolved_at, 0 AS total
FROM n_moderation_reports r WHERE r.report_id = :report_id
sql.lock:
SELECT status, handled_by, CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_resolved
FROM n_moderation_reports WHERE report_id = :report_id FOR UPDATE
sql.update:
UPDATE n_moderation_reports
SET status = :status, handled_by = :handled_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    resolved_at = CASE WHEN :status IN ('resolved', 'dismissed') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END
WHERE report_id = :report_id
sql.findOpen: SELECT report_id, reason, description, evidence_url, priority FROM (SELECT report_id, reason, description, evidence_url, priority FROM n_moderation_reports WHERE target_type = :target_type AND target_id = :target_id AND reporter_user_id = :viewer_id AND status IN ('pending','in_review') ORDER BY report_id DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
sql.next: SELECT seq_moderation_report_id.NEXTVAL AS report_id FROM dual
sql.mergeCase:
MERGE INTO n_moderation_cases c USING (
  SELECT s.target_type, s.target_id, s.report_count, s.latest_reported_at,
    CASE s.priority_rank WHEN 4 THEN 'urgent' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'normal' ELSE 'low' END AS report_priority,
    CASE WHEN s.target_type IN ('post','comment','group_post','group_comment')
      AND s.open_reporters >= CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.setting_value, '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$', 'c') THEN CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(a.setting_value) <= 9007199254740991 THEN TO_NUMBER(a.setting_value) END
      END
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS threshold_met
  FROM (
    SELECT target_type, target_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count, MAX(created_at) AS latest_reported_at,
      MAX(CASE priority WHEN 'urgent' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'normal' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS priority_rank,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status IN ('pending','in_review') THEN reporter_user_id END) AS open_reporters
    FROM n_moderation_reports WHERE target_type = :target_type AND target_id = :target_id
    GROUP BY target_type, target_id
  ) s
  LEFT JOIN n_moderation_settings a ON a.setting_key = 'auto_hide_report_threshold'
) r ON (c.target_type = r.target_type AND c.target_id = r.target_id)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  c.report_count = r.report_count, c.latest_reported_at = r.latest_reported_at,
  c.priority = CASE WHEN c.status IN ('pending','flagged') AND r.threshold_met = 1
    AND r.report_priority IN ('low','normal') THEN 'high' ELSE r.report_priority END,
  c.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (case_id,target_type,target_id,status,priority,report_count,latest_reported_at)
VALUES (seq_moderation_case_id.NEXTVAL,r.target_type,r.target_id,'pending',
  CASE WHEN r.threshold_met = 1 AND r.report_priority IN ('low','normal') THEN 'high' ELSE r.report_priority END,
  r.report_count,r.latest_reported_at)

targets.post: SELECT p.post_id AS target_id FROM n_posts p WHERE p.post_id = :target_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id, p.post_id) = 1 FOR UPDATE
targets.comment: SELECT c.comment_id AS target_id FROM n_comments c WHERE c.comment_id = :target_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id, c.post_id) = 1 FOR UPDATE
targets.user: SELECT u.user_id AS target_id FROM n_users u WHERE u.user_id = :target_id AND u.is_active = 1 AND fn_get_user_relationship(:viewer_id, u.user_id) NOT IN ('blocking', 'blocked_by') FOR UPDATE
targets.group_post: SELECT p.post_id AS target_id FROM n_group_posts p WHERE p.post_id = :target_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_groups g WHERE g.group_id = p.group_id AND g.is_active = 1 AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND (g.privacy = 'public' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_group_members m WHERE m.group_id = g.group_id AND m.user_id = :viewer_id AND m.status = 'active'))) FOR UPDATE
targets.group_comment: SELECT c.comment_id AS target_id FROM n_group_comments c WHERE c.comment_id = :target_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_group_posts p JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id = p.group_id WHERE p.post_id = c.post_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND g.is_active = 1 AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND (g.privacy = 'public' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_group_members m WHERE m.group_id = g.group_id AND m.user_id = :viewer_id AND m.status = 'active'))) FOR UPDATE
